Author: Sansflaire
Name: LimLo Toolkit
Punchline: A standalone box of small quality-of-life tools.
Description: LimLoToolkit is a single window that collects small quality-of-life tools: a live character and zone readout, an Eorzea clock with the next weather window, and more to come. Every tool can be switched on or off individually. The plugin is fully standalone — it needs no other plugins installed and talks to nothing outside the game.
